verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform has an API for listing deployments, findings, and projects (semgrep-docs-17). However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and every probed OpenAPI/Swagger path on the docs site returned 404 (semgrep-probe-2). Because the axis applies to an API-bearing platform and the spec is not evidenced, the verdict is none rather than na.
